description: The pie chart titled “NearSameEntity” presents the distribution of instances across relation categories for this setting, shown as a single pie divided into 10 slices with counts and percentages printed on or near each slice. The slices are labeled NearSameEntity (dark gray, 63, 6.34%), RelativePosition (light gray, 81, 7.90%), MentalitySimilarity (light cyan, 89, 8.67%), SimilarEvent (light blue, 90, 8.77%), AppearanceSimilarity (pale green, 90, 8.77%), Layout (light yellow, 90, 8.77%), an unlabeled teal slice showing 90 (8.77%) with its label obscured by a small gray rectangle, UsageSimilarity (salmon/orange, 100, 9.65%), SubEvent (red/pink, 100, 9.74%), SimilarMaterial (orange, 106, 10.33%), and ObservationAngle (mint green, 126, 12.28%). There is no separate legend, and no slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized; the segments do not appear strictly ordered by size around the circle.
